# Version 4.157.0
> **Skia m157 rendering corrections** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.157.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.0 brings Skia m157 with raster, text and GPU rendering corrections. The preview line also makes LibraryImport calling conventions explicit. Release Candidate 1 adds reflected-hairline and text-atlas fixes and a targeted Mali Vulkan device-loss workaround.

## Breaking Changes

- **Check the native Graphite Metal runtime minimum** — Native Graphite Metal now requires iOS/tvOS 15; its macOS minimum remains 12. If you use that backend directly, update deployment targets accordingly. These are native-backend minima, not replacements for any higher managed-package or framework requirements. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Engine

- **Skia milestone 157** — Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m157 while preserving the existing managed API surface and the glyph-bounds guard carried from m156. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Bug Fixes

- **Raster and glyph-replay correctness** — Fixes coverage-mask clamping, convex-path device bounds and a heap overflow in convex anti-aliased paths across vertical clip gaps. Adds direct-mask Slug validation and corrects unsupported fractional glyph replay. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630))
- **GPU clipping and readback** — Corrects Graphite clip-key packing, wedge inflation and A-to-RGBx GPU-to-CPU transfer stride, and initializes Vulkan render-pass pointers correctly. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630))
- **Reflected hairlines and text-atlas selection** — Keeps zero-length square-capped hairlines correctly sized under reflected transforms and rounds Ganesh text-atlas indices to avoid selecting the wrong atlas. Adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 up to, but not including, 56. ([#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670))
- **Explicit cdecl interop** — LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching the existing DllImport paths across SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp, SceneGraph, Skottie and Resources. This addresses an ABI mismatch that can affect Windows x86; runtime confirmation of the reported stack-growth symptom remains outstanding. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

HarfBuzzSharp's generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching the existing DllImport convention. This corrects a potential Windows x86 ABI mismatch without changing the public managed API.

## Release Candidate 1 (November 9, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and Ganesh text-atlas selection. It also adds a targeted Mali Vulkan device-loss cleanup workaround.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1...v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay and Graphite readback corrections, plus explicit cdecl LibraryImport metadata. Native Graphite Metal now requires iOS/tvOS 15; higher managed-package requirements still apply.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.0...v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)
